function.name: list_files
function.description: List one project directory on demand; defaults to root only. Directories and files are returned as entries. Follow next_offset when hasMore. Optional recursive=true lists scoped descendant file paths in pages. Dependencies, build outputs, private paths and links are excluded.

path.description: Directory relative to project root; empty means root

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read lines of a UTF-8 source file. Defaults to first 200 lines, max 400 lines. Follow hasMore to read further.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search literal text in UTF-8 source including large files. Optional path scopes a file or directory. Results are bounded by matches, scanned characters and files; when hasMore, continue with next_file_offset as file_offset and next_offset as offset, keeping query/path unchanged. Check skipped files and report incomplete coverage.

function.name: propose_file
function.description: Write a complete source file if task allows edits; otherwise stage it for review. Must read existing file first. Never delete files.

content.description: Complete new file content, not a patch

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Persist a short task checkpoint: goal interpretation, observable acceptance criteria, steps, failures and next action. Preserve facts, not hidden reasoning.

evidence.description: Compact confirmed facts with provenance; do not copy source or command output. File evidence can include path and the digest returned by read_file. Command evidence can include commandId.

todo.description: Ordered concrete next steps, up to 12.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run supervised commands from the local execution environment: Node/npm/Python project checks, or ssh [-p port] user@host 'remote command'. SSH uses this computer's OpenSSH, known_hosts, config and agent/key; an optional password uses one-shot Python SSH without app SSH setup. Never put a password in args or remote command; use the password field only when the user supplied it. SSH may await approval and its result must be read with command_result. Local source changes still require behavioral tests and review_diff. No local shell, pip, installs or arbitrary modules.

purpose.description: What user acceptance criterion this validates

password.description: Optional one-time SSH password explicitly supplied by the user. Never include it in args, purpose or remote command. Encrypted only while pending/executing; hidden from command history and results.

retry_id.description: Explicitly retry a failed/interrupted command ID after inspecting its result

function.name: command_result
function.description: Read status and bounded output of a command by ID. Poll running commands before assuming success; do not run them again.

function.name: review_diff
function.description: Inspect applied changes, external conflicts and current project fingerprint. Run after the last modification and after checks.

function.name: finish_task
function.description: Declare completion with evidence. Change tasks require a successful behavioral check against current files and a current diff review. A summary alone cannot complete a task.

summary.description: One or two concise sentences stating the outcome. Put detailed topics in cards.

evidence.description: Begin with one brief user-visible note about observed verification or static review. Put additional coverage and limits in later sentences for the task record. Do not repeat card contents or make an evidence card.

cards.description: Group the user-facing answer into numbered topic cards, usually 2–4. Use a short title and concise bullet items; include source references where relevant. Never create an analysis/evidence/scope card; that belongs in the short footer note. Omit cards for a very short answer.

function.name: request_user
function.description: Call immediately when a material requirement, fact, scope, preference, or consequence cannot be reliably established with available project evidence/tools, when evidence conflicts, or when a user choice is required. Pause dependent actions; do not guess or defer the question. State confirmed facts, the specific unresolved point and impact, why tools cannot resolve it, and optional independent work already completed. This waits for the user and is never completion.

function.name: fail_task
function.description: Report that the task could not be completed after reasonable recovery. Preserve concrete evidence and explain the failure or unsupported verification. Never claim success. Use request_user only if a specific user answer can unblock work.
